title: Let a folder addition use open-descendant capacity freed since a root's tasks were imported
outcome: Let a folder addition use open-descendant capacity freed since a root's tasks were imported
acceptance: A folder import that adds a child under a root whose imported tasks once reached the open-descendant limit, but which now holds fewer open descendants because some ended, admits the addition instead of refusing it as origin_graph over the open-descendant limit
The import-origin history check still refuses additions that would close a cycle through the original origin structure
